reported.title: No debounce/settle window
reported.description: The sketch toggles on every raw falling edge with no 50 ms settle window, so a 22 ms bounce burst produces multiple toggles per physical press.

reported.title: No hysteresis on release
reported.description: priorSample is updated every loop with the raw sample, so bounce on release (HIGH/LOW chatter) can create spurious falling edges and extra toggles.

reported.title: Unused bootMs variable
reported.description: bootMs is assigned but never used; harmless but indicates the intended settle timing was never implemented.

truth.description: Immediate edge detect counts bounce as presses

truth_for_judge.description: Immediate edge detect counts bounce as presses

exposing_checks.behaviour: D9 toggles exactly once per settled press on None (One armed toggle per estop press)

judge_input.spec:
- Shop estop pushbutton on D6 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); machine-armed indicator on D9.
- Each settled press toggles D9 exactly once within 150 ms; release must not toggle.
- Bounce bursts up to 22 ms must not produce more than one toggle per physical press.
- Use a 50 ms settle window before accepting a press.
- Print `shop armed=<0|1> presses=<n>` every 1200 ms.
- Unpressed idle level is HIGH on D6.
